items.stem: Claude's account summary asserts a buying trigger that the supplied notes do not mention. What is the right action?

options.text: Treat it as an unsupported inference and verify before use
options.rationale: Correct: inferences not grounded in the inputs must be checked, not assumed.

options.text: Include it in the proposal because it is persuasive
options.rationale: Persuasiveness does not make an ungrounded claim true.

options.text: Ask Claude to add supporting detail
options.rationale: Asking the model to elaborate does not establish the claim.

options.text: Drop all of Claude's summary to be safe
options.rationale: Discarding everything over one unsupported point is disproportionate.

items.explanation: Correct: inferences not grounded in the inputs must be checked, not assumed.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO conditions should be met before a Claude-informed proposal is sent? (Select TWO.)

options.text: A human has reviewed the intelligence the proposal relies on
options.rationale: Correct: a review gate catches unverified or wrong claims.

options.text: Key claims are backed by a recorded source
options.rationale: Correct: sourced claims are defensible to the customer.

options.text: The proposal was generated in a single pass for speed
options.rationale: Speed is not a safeguard against error.

options.text: All account intelligence is included regardless of relevance
options.rationale: Dumping everything weakens the proposal and the review.

items.explanation: Correct: a review gate catches unverified or wrong claims.

items.stem: How should synthesised intelligence be recorded on a Salesforce opportunity?

options.text: As sourced, dated notes linked to the correct account
options.rationale: Correct: provenance and correct linkage make the record trustworthy.

options.text: As free text with no source, to save time
options.rationale: Unsourced notes cannot be judged or defended later.

options.text: On any related record so it is easy to find
options.rationale: Loose linkage corrupts reporting and relationships.

options.text: Only in the proposal document, not the CRM
options.rationale: Keeping it out of the CRM loses the shared record of truth.

items.explanation: Correct: provenance and correct linkage make the record trustworthy.
